title: Cantonese-Style Stir-Fry
description: A classic Chinese dish made with juicy pork, quick-cooked in a savory sauce.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced pork and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from the wok and set aside.
In the same wok, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and stir-fry until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add the cooked pork back into the wok and stir in the soy sauce and hoisin sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the chopped scallions and serve hot.
Serve immediately and garnish with additional scallions if desired.
